mutations.name: the window read opens a writable connection
kills: readF11Window opens the log read-only, so a missing database is an error and no file appears

mutations.name: the window includes its until instant
kills: readF11Window returns the rows observed in [since, until), in seq order

mutations.name: the window excludes its since instant
kills: readF11Window returns the rows observed in [since, until), in seq order

mutations.name: an unparseable bound is not refused by name
kills: f11Window refuses an unparseable or empty window

mutations.name: a webhook row past its withinMs is pending, not webhookOnly
kills: F11 clock 2 over a stored window reports an unconfirmed webhook row as webhookOnly and one whose withinMs runs past until as pending
